| Gutter | `round(nearest, clamp(24px, 5vw, 80px), 8px)` |
| Related text | 12–16px |
| Content gap | `--content-gap`, 24px |

nodes.label: Current behavior (docs/alan-character.md)

Fine-pointer movement selects rendered head views in 45-degree sectors, with a neutral radius and hysteresis against jitter. Tracking waits for required neutral images; an early valid pointer position is retained while loading. Face/expression changes blend over 150ms. Separate body/arm blends use the numeric 240ms pose duration and a 12-degree shoulder arc. The bubble says Hi! Nice to meet you! and transitions over 150ms.

Isolated additive blend groups normalize current weights before an interrupted animation is replaced, keeping each group's weights at one. Face direction/expression share one blend; body/arm transitions do not restart for a head turn. The lowered sleeve stays fixed and the shoulder overlap covers the masked seam.

Keyboard focus/activation greets immediately; Escape dismisses without moving focus. Touch taps greet and outside taps dismiss. Reduced motion, forced colors, and unsupported additive blending use immediate pose changes. Touch/preferences omit directional head-image loading. Tracking pauses offscreen and in hidden tabs, and window exit returns the head forward. Frame-batched pointer/geometry work updates React state only when direction changes.

Light is the default regardless of device preference. The explicit Dark theme switch stores a choice under `portfolio-theme-v1` when permitted. An early inline script reads it before body paint; hydration reconciles changes, and tabs synchronize stored updates. Storage failure leaves the switch usable for the session. No-JavaScript pages stay light and omit inactive switches. Print uses light surfaces.

Cobalt remains `#245bff` in both themes. Filled actions retain white text; small action text/icons use cobalt in light mode and ink in dark mode. Raised neutrals differ from fields and the subdued surface. Original project imagery, role colors, gradient icons, and supplied logo shading remain authored colors.

The 88×48px switch has native switch semantics, the stable accessible name Dark theme, and a checked state. Its 36px thumb travels 40px over the shared 250ms selection duration. Keyboard focus, reduced motion, and forced colors settle immediately. The full header, compact rail, and menu share it; the compact/menu controls put it immediately left of Menu/Close.

Test both themes and runtime changes, storage denial, keyboard/touch, enlarged text, contrast preferences, no JavaScript, and print when relevant. [Quality checks](quality.md) records actual coverage.
